main_text.head: ORATIO VIII. DE MORTE ET RESVR-RECTIONE CHRISTI, con-ferens oraculum Iesaiæ cap. 53. cum historia Evan-gelica,
main_text.p: Recitata ab ANDREA CELLARIO Pridie Paschatis, Anno 1592.

SOLENNEM beneficiorum mortis ac resur-rectionis Christi celebrationem in Ecclesia nostra & schola quotannis repetendam & con-servandam esse Auditores neminem equidem ex vobis dubitare existimo. Eam enim magno cum usu fructuque eximio nostro conjunctam esse, facile intelligunt omnes, qui & gloriam Servato-ris sui, & salutem propriam curæ habent. Augescit ac roboratur hinc fides nostra, qua indubi-tante assensione credimus, Iesum Nazarenum crucifixum ac mortuum propter peccata nostra, & suscitatum propter justificationem nostram, juxta Prophetarum oracula, verè Messiam illum esse, patribus à Deo promissum. Capit præterea[?]

page.notes: The first word "SOLENNEM" opens with a large initial S, joined to the word. "præterea" is at the line end and partly cut; the reading is uncertain. The signature "Qo v." is read as "Qq v." or "Qo v."; the letter is unclear. Faint show-through of the facing page is visible at the left and in the upper middle of the page and is not transcribed.
